name: 内部服务 (7GB)
description_en_html:
Overview

This scope item covers the in-house service process in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition.

In-House Service provides activities for repair and service performed in service centers of a manufacturer or a service provider. Such activities are logistics, quotation processing, diagnosis, repairing, and triggering billing. The integration with customer returns ensures the inbound and outbound delivery for in-house service objects (service objects) sent back by customers. Costs and revenues that occurred during the in-house service are posted to accounting and can be used for detailed cost-benefit analysis.

In-House Service provides the following options within the in-house service process to plan and perform a service:

  • In-House Service with Service

    If you intend to plan and perform in-house services within service quotations and service orders, you define the details (for example, labor, service parts, or expenses) that are required to perform and bill the service in the service quotation and the service order under Items.

    When the customer accepts the service quotation, the system creates a service order as a follow-up that is used to plan and perform the actual in-house service. During the service, you create service confirmations as a follow-up to the service order to confirm the time sheet entries for the actual labor performed, and to confirm the service parts consumed and the actual expenses. The costs incurred are posted to accounting. Once the in-house service is finalized, you release the recorded effort for billing. This creates a billing document request that is used to invoice the in-house service to the customer.

  • In-House Service with Advanced Execution

    If you plan and perform the in-house service in the advanced execution process, service quotations and service orders are used to document the commercial processing of the in-house service while maintenance orders are used to document the planning and the execution of the in-house service.

    The system creates a maintenance order as a follow-up to a service quotation or a service order once you change the status of the execution order item to status In Process (service quotation) or Released (service order). In the maintenance order, you can use task lists to plan the in-house service and create confirmations to confirm the actual labor performed and the components consumed. Having done this, the actual costs that have occurred are posted to accounting. You can use resource-related billing to create debit memo requests to invoice the customer.

  • Common process steps in In-House Service

    In-House Service integrates with customer returns: For both options that are provided within the in-house process, you can trigger the inbound and outbound delivery for the service objects using customer returns.

    You can determine the relevant service contracts for the service quotations and service orders that allow to automatically calculate the prices.

    Costs and revenues that have occurred during the in-house service are posted to accounting and are used for a detailed cost-benefit analysis.

Key Process Flow

  • Receive the in-house service object (service object) using customer returns
  • Create the in-house service
  • Add the service object to the in-house service or remove service objects from it
  • Check the service contracts and warranties that are related to the in-house service or the service object
  • Perform a precheck for the service object and decide to perform an in-house service for the service object
  • Plan and perform a diagnosis to prepare the service quotation and charge the costs to the customer that have occurred during the diagnosis
  • Create and send out the service quotation
  • Create a maintenance order as a follow-up to the service quotation that is used to plan the cost and labor consumption for the requested service
  • Accept or reject service quotation
  • Create a service order for the service object, and add service items, expense items, service part items, or fixed price items that are required to perform and bill the service
  • Add or change the service order items. Use templates or product proposals to add predefined items to the service order
  • Create a maintenance order as a follow-up to the service order that is used to plan and perform the in-house service when using Service with Advanced Execution
  • Create purchase requisitions for the non-stock spare parts that have been added to the service order
  • Confirm the in-house service using service confirmations or confirmations in Plant Maintenance
  • Release the service order and the related service confirmations for billing, create a billing document request or use resource-related billing to bill the in-house service
  • Create a billing document for billing document requests or debit memo requests to bill the in-house service to the customer
  • Post revenues automatically that have been incurred for the service order items
  • Trigger the outbound delivery to send the service object back to the customer

Business Benefits

  • Provide capabilities to select, plan, and perform the in-house service process for equipment
  • Integrate with customer returns to perform the logistics process for the in-house service objects (service objects)
  • Support the planning of the in-house service using templates, product proposals, and task lists
  • Use service quotations to provide cost estimates to the customer
  • Determine service contracts for service orders and service quotations
  • Trigger the procurement of non-stock service parts within the service order processing
  • Post time sheets, spare parts, and expenses automatically
  • Invoice the customer using order-based, confirmation-based, or resource-related billing
  • Provide APIs that are used to trigger the in-house service from an external system
description_zh_html:
概览

此范围项目涵盖 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 中的内部服务流程。

内部服务 为在制造商或服务提供商的服务中心执行的维修和服务提供活动。此类活动包括物流、报价处理、诊断、维修和触发开票。与客户退货的集成可确保客户发送回的内部服务对象（服务对象）的入库和出库交货。内部服务期间产生的成本和收入将过账到会计核算，并可用于详细的成本收益分析。

内部服务在内部服务流程中提供以下选项来计划和执行服务：

  • 使用服务的内部服务

    如果要在服务报价和服务订单中计划和执行内部服务，请在项目下定义在服务报价和服务订单中执行和开票服务所需的详细信息（例如，人工、服务部件或费用）。

    客户接受服务报价后，系统会创建服务订单作为后续订单，用于计划和执行实际内部服务。在服务期间，您创建服务确认作为服务订单的后续，以确认实际执行人工的时间表条目，并确认消耗的服务部件和实际费用。产生的成本将过账到会计核算。内部服务完成后，审批记录的工作量以进行开票。这将创建一个开票凭证请求，用于向客户开具内部服务发票。

  • 使用高级执行的内部服务

    如果您在高级执行流程中计划和执行内部服务，则服务报价和服务订单用于记录内部服务的商业处理，而维护订单用于记录内部服务的计划和执行。

    将执行订单项目的状态更改为处理中（服务报价）或已审批（服务订单）后，系统会创建维护订单作为服务报价或服务订单的后续。在维护订单中，您可以使用任务清单计划内部服务，并创建确认以确认实际执行的人工和消耗的组件。完成此操作后，产生的实际成本将过账到会计核算。您可以使用资源相关开票来创建借项凭证请求以向客户开发票。

  • 内部服务中的常见流程步骤

    内部服务与客户退货集成：对于内部流程中提供的两个选项，您可以使用客户退货触发服务对象的入库和出库交货。

    您可以确定服务报价和服务订单的相关服务合同，以便自动计算价格。

    在内部服务期间发生的成本和收入将过账到会计核算，并用于详细的成本收益分析。

关键流程流

  • 使用客户退货接收内部服务对象（服务对象）
  • 创建内部服务
  • 将服务对象添加到内部服务，或从中移除服务对象
  • 检查与内部服务或服务对象相关的服务合同和质保。
  • 对服务对象执行预检查，并决定为服务对象执行内部服务
  • 计划和执行诊断，以准备服务报价，并向客户收取诊断期间发生的成本
  • 创建并发送服务报价
  • 创建维护订单作为服务报价的后续，该服务报价用于计划请求服务的成本和人工消耗
  • 接受或拒绝服务报价
  • 为服务对象创建服务订单，并添加执行和开票服务所需的服务项目、费用项目、备件项目或固定价格项目
  • 添加或更改服务订单项目。使用模板或产品建议，将预定义项目添加到服务订单
  • 使用具有高级执行的服务时，创建维护订单作为用于计划和执行内部服务的服务订单的后续
  • 为已添加到服务订单的非库存备件创建采购申请。
  • 使用工厂维护中的服务确认或确认，确认内部服务
  • 审批服务订单和相关服务确认以进行开票，创建开票凭证请求或使用资源相关开票对内部服务开票
  • 为开票凭证请求或借项凭证请求创建开票凭证，以向客户开票内部服务
  • 自动过账服务订单项目产生的收入。
  • 触发出库交货，以将服务对象发送回客户

业务优势

  • 提供选择、计划和执行设备内部服务流程的功能
  • 与客户退货集成以执行内部服务对象（服务对象）的物流流程
  • 支持使用模板、产品建议和任务清单计划内部服务
  • 使用服务报价，向客户提供成本估算
  • 确定服务订单和服务报价的服务合同
  • 在服务订单处理中触发非库存服务部件的采购。
  • 自动过账时间表、备件和费用
  • 使用基于订单、基于确认或资源相关的开票为客户开发票
  • 提供用于从外部系统触发内部服务的 API
